title: Harris's father, a clarinet and saxophone player, and his band photograph
summary: Harris says his father played with name bands; a picture on the wall is taken down to look at.

blocks.x: My father was a musician. He played with all the name bands and he was sitting there all.
What instrument did he play? Pyronet and Saxophone.
Pyronet and Saxophone. What band he played was the regular band?
Well, the regular band, they had a band of the old, I don't even know the name of it. That's part of the band there. I don't really know. Oh, that's a picture over there.
Can I take this off the wall? Yeah, you can.
Maybe you can just tell us what it is and we should have.

Some day we'll make a copy of that. I should have brought our camera today. Today, I just got back from a trip upstate and up to, over to Texas and all last night, so I didn't get things organized quite for today.
